newsitem.title: INDONESIA: At least one dead in East Timor crowd violence.
newsitem.headline: At least one dead in East Timor crowd violence.

text.p: At least one person died in an attack by a group of youths at the cathedral in the East Timor capital of Dili on Tuesday, residents said.

Two were seriously injured in another incident at Dili's Komoro airport where tens of thousands of East Timorese had gathered to greet Noble peace laureate Bishop Carlos Belo on his arrival back home from a trip to Europe, they said.

"We saw at least one person dead at the cathedral," one resident said. Others said the man, in plain clothes, was attacked after he was found carrying a pistol and walkie-talkie radio as thousands gathered for an afternoon mass Belo was due to give.

Another resident said that two men in civilian clothes were attacked at the airport and had their car burnt after the crowd saw a rifle, pistol and grenades in the vehicle. He said rumours have been rife in Dili in recent days that an attack would be made on Belo.

Colonel Atok Rismanto, deputy East Timor police chief, told Reuters three armed forces members had been hospitalised with wounds that were neither serious nor light after they were attacked in a "brutal" action by the crowds.

Belo is the most popular local figure in the former Portuguese colony. His often strong stand against human rights abuses since the 1975 Indonesian invasion has earned him deep respect in the majority Catholic territory.
